answer: A port scanning attack works by utilizing a combination of techniques to determine the state of the ports on a remote system. Each service or application that uses TCP or UDP networking will have specific ports open for communication. By scanning these ports, an attacker can identify which services are available on the target system, which can be a precursor to further exploitation or attacks [Source 1].
